'''Shroud SF-13''' was an operative of the spymaster known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] that was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] just prior to the [[Battle of Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].
